| Category = Fish recipes
| Difficulty = 3
}}

{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* 4 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. (24 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]]) wild [[Cookbook:Salmon|salmon]] filets with skin, pin bones removed
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Soy Sauce|soy sauce]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]] [[Cookbook:Ginger|ginger]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] minced [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]]
* 2 tbsp rice [[Cookbook:Wine vinegar|wine vinegar]]
* 1 ½ tsp [[Cookbook:Grater|grated]] [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon]] [[Cookbook:Zest|zest]]
* 1 tbsp light [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]]
* 2 Thai bird [[Cookbook:Chiles|chiles]], stemmed
* [[Cookbook:Sesame Oil|Sesame oil]]

== Equipment ==
* Kettle grill
* Large chimney starter
* Natural chunk or hardwood lump charcoal
* Kitchen towel tied into a roll and soaked in vegetable oil
* Gallon-size resealable plastic bags
* [[Cookbook:Paper Towel|Paper towels]]

== Procedure ==
#Combine all ingredients except salmon in a [[Cookbook:Blender|blender]] until smooth. Pour into a plastic bag and add salmon. Toss to coat, seal, removing as much air as possible, and refrigerate up to 4 hours.
#Remove salmon from marinade and pat dry with paper towels. [[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] all sides with oil.
#Preheat 4½ pounds charcoal in starter. Once hot, disperse evenly around bottom of grill. Reapply grate and once hot, swab with towel.
#Add salmon to hottest part of grill skin side up, and cook 3–5 minutes per side for medium, rotating 90 degrees halfway to make grill marks.
#Remove to a plate and cover tightly with [[Cookbook:Aluminium Foil|aluminum foil]]. Let rest 5 minutes before serving.
